research_question: Can the final-blind handoff represent and freeze semantic, replay-capability and executable-source layers without leaking any expected outcome into the public manifest?
v1_gap_audit: public units name only a broad lifecycle phase, not the exact sample_apply/replay_apply/cache operation
analyzer_bundle does not freeze capability/source-index systems or their schemas
units do not preregister callable binding components, slot policy, capability mechanism/checks or lineage roles
private oracle cannot separately score semantic safety and framework capability
metric gates do not separately measure capability/source resolution and final safe-opportunity recall

unit_contract_plan: semantic analyzer entrypoint and required effect dimensions
capability mechanism and exact required checks
lineage operand names/roles without content digests
source-index schema, binding components/callable slots and fail-closed Unknown policy
public_v2_requirements.forbidden: No expected semantic decision, capability status, final status, reason, safety hint, content digest or oracle-derived field may be public.

private_v2_requirements: independently reviewed expected semantic decision and coarse reason
expected capability status/reason for rewrite units; not_applicable for candidate kind none
no source-index expected support label because that is implementation coverage, not ground truth semantics
administrative_self_tests: valid 60-unit public/private fixture, commitment, verification and full execution-support seal
stored-record plan without parameter_record role rejected
target-dependent operand not declared in lineage rejected
source Unknown policy other than fail_closed rejected
placeholder component hashes rejected in sealed mode
public/private unit mismatch and post-commit tampering rejected
candidate none with non-not_applicable capability oracle rejected
rewrite candidate with not_applicable capability oracle rejected
seal contains every declared system/adapter/schema file and no private-oracle path
success_gates: v2 validator and templates import/run without opening any real final source or oracle
valid public fixture contains no forbidden outcome-bearing keys
execution freeze covers effect, capability, source-index, runner, adapters and schemas
v1 files and P4b frozen inputs remain unchanged
falsification_rules: Do not put expected capability support in the public plan merely to make the runner easier to configure.
A callable slot list is configuration, not an oracle label, but must be selected before prediction.
Do not treat source-index Unknown as semantic incorrect; report it as implementation coverage.
Do not infer final safe-admit recall by dropping Unsupported or Unknown safe units from the denominator.
Administrative PASS means ready for handoff only; it is not a final benchmark result.
If a guardrail fails, retain v0 and create a new protocol before weakening it.
